section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1976
title: 11 The volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was more for Metropolitan Cities like previous year. Although no specific reason could be assigned for the large variation in the volume of accidental deaths in the different States/U.Ts./ Metropolitan Cities, but difference in topography, population, level of industrialisation and other socioeconomic factors may have contributed to the phenomenon. Among the States, the volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was the maximum in Maharashtra (43.93) followed by Madhya Pradesh (33.55), Karnataka (21.77) and Gujarat (18.15). The minimum volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population was for the State of Manipur (5.19). The volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population for the Union Territories as a whole was 38.39. The maximum was for Pondicherry (53.82). Only two Union Territories registered less volume of accidental deaths per lakh of population than the all-India average. These were Mizoram (9.61) and Arunachal Pradesh (9.23).
